name: Shell Game
target: 2 unattended objects, which must each be of light Bulk or less
text:
The two targets instantaneously swap locations. You must have a rough idea where each target is located, but neither can be directly observed by any creature (including you) or the spell fails.

---
Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 30 feet, and each of the targets can be of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (5th) As 3rd rank, and one of the objects you target can be either in your possession or in the possession of a willing creature in range.

Heightened (7th) As 5th rank, but the range increases to 60 feet and both objects can be either in your possession or in the possession of a willing creature in range.
